title: Fetters
html:
• Aṅguttara Nikāya 7.8 Numbered Discourses 7.8
  • 1. Dhanavagga 1. Wealth

Saṁyojanasutta Fetters

“Sattimāni, bhikkhave, saṁyojanāni. “Mendicants, there are these seven fetters. Katamāni satta? What seven? Anunayasaṁyojanaṁ, paṭighasaṁyojanaṁ, diṭṭhisaṁyojanaṁ, vicikicchāsaṁyojanaṁ, mānasaṁyojanaṁ, bhavarāgasaṁyojanaṁ, avijjāsaṁyojanaṁ. The fetters of attraction, aversion, views, doubt, conceit, desire for continued existence, and ignorance. Imāni kho, bhikkhave, satta saṁyojanānī”ti. These are the seven fetters.”

Aṭṭhamaṁ.
